title: doppelscan config
description:
doppelscan settings for a repository (.doppelscan.toml). Flags and MCP
tool arguments override them.

accept.description:
Clone groups the team has decided to keep, by fingerprint. They are
left out of every report and never fail `check`, however many
copies there are. A change to the code's structure changes the
fingerprint, so the clone comes back for another look; renames and
changed literals do not, unless the scan is strict.

exclude.description: .gitignore patterns, relative to this file, to leave out.

include.description:
.gitignore patterns, relative to this file, of directories the
built-in skip list leaves out that should be scanned. What they
name is scanned even when marked as generated.

max-param-density.description:
Groups needing more parameters than this per 100 tokens are dropped
as data tables. Default 8.

min-tokens.description: Smallest clone reported, in syntax tokens. Default 50.

only.description:
Only these languages, by name or extension; yaml is scanned only
when listed.

root.description: Stop looking for configs in parent directories.

strict.description: Match identifiers and literals exactly (copy-paste clones only).

fingerprint.description: The group's fingerprint, as `doppelscan` shows it in brackets.

min-tokens.description:
Only new clone groups of at least this many tokens fail the check;
smaller ones are still reported. Default: the report's min-tokens.

exclude.description:
.gitignore patterns, relative to this file, that near leaves out
(tests are near copies of each other by design).
